planQuinquenal.abrirAria: Open the Five-Year Mining Development Plan 2026–2030
planQuinquenal.imageAlt: Five-Year Mining Development Plan of La Rioja 2026–2030
planQuinquenal.title: Five-Year Mining Development Plan 2026–2030
planQuinquenal.parrafo1: The Five-Year Mining Development Plan sets out the roadmap for La Rioja's mining policy for the 2026–2030 period. Its purpose is to turn the province's geological and human potential into productive development, employment, investment and opportunities for the communities of La Rioja.
planQuinquenal.parrafo2: The Plan promotes modern, sustainable, transparent and inclusive mining with a provincial identity. To achieve these goals, it brings together public policy, investment, education, citizen participation, technological innovation, environmental protection and institutional strengthening.
planQuinquenal.parrafo3: Its roadmap is organized into five strategic pillars: institutional and regulatory modernization; education, employment and territory; environment and community; investment and local economy; and mining communication.

mision.title: Mission
mision.texto: To promote, regulate and oversee mining activity in La Rioja so that it is carried out responsibly, sustainably and transparently, and translates into jobs, opportunities and well-being for the people of La Rioja. We do this in coordination with communities, municipalities, the productive sector and the educational and scientific system, strengthening mining that is integrated into the territorial and productive development of the province.

oro.descripcion: It is a soft transition metal that is usually found in its native state, as nuggets and in alluvial deposits. Economic concentrations typically occur in hydrothermal systems (veins and disseminations) and in secondary placer deposits formed by the erosion of primary sources. It is characterized by its high economic value, low alterability, excellent conductivity, great malleability, ductility and resistance to corrosion, which makes it a resource of great importance.

reservaValor.detalle: used as a financial asset and economic backing.

industriaElectronica.detalle: present in circuits and components because of its stability and conductivity. It is used in high-reliability connectors, switches and cables in mobile phones, computers and satellites because of its resistance to corrosion.

medicinaOdontologia.detalle: used in fillings, dental crowns and drugs for rheumatoid arthritis.

industriaAeroespacial.detalle: gold foil is used to reflect infrared radiation in space suits and satellites.

plata.descripcion: It is a grayish-white precious metal that can occur in its native state or as part of minerals such as sulfides (for example, argentiferous galena). It is usually found associated with other metals, especially gold, in hydrothermal systems. It has the highest electrical and thermal conductivity of all metals, as well as good malleability and ductility, antibacterial properties and relative resistance to corrosion. These properties make it widely used.

joyeriaOrfebreria.detalle: used in alloys to increase hardness and to make jewelry, cutlery and decorative objects.

industriaElectronica.detalle: its main industrial use. In contacts, circuits and electrical components such as high-end components, switches, solar panels, batteries and connectors in electronic devices because of its low resistance.

aplicacionesIndustrialesQuimicas.detalle: in alloys, catalysts and chemical processes.

medicinaSalud.detalle: used in antimicrobial dressings, burn creams, medical instruments and dental amalgams.

purificacionAgua.detalle: used to disinfect drinking water and swimming pools because of its antibacterial properties.

cobre.descripcion: It is a reddish transition metal that occurs in nature in its native state, but mainly combined with other elements as part of sulfides (such as chalcopyrite), oxides and carbonates. Its deposits are found mainly in hydrothermal systems and porphyry-type deposits, where it can occur in large low-grade volumes. It is characterized by high electrical and thermal conductivity, ductility, malleability and resistance to corrosion, which makes it one of the most widely used metals in the world. It is 100% recyclable and essential to the electrical, construction and transport industries and, more recently, to health care because of its antimicrobial properties.

industriaElectrica.detalle: main component of cables, conductors and electronic components (transformers, generators, internet networks).

aleacionesMetalicas.detalle: manufacture of alloys such as bronze and brass.

construccion.detalle: drinking water and gas pipes, HVAC systems, roofing and structural materials.

transporte.detalle: essential in the engines of cars (especially electric ones), trains, ships and aircraft.

innovacionSalud.detalle: antimicrobial surfaces in hospitals, fabrics with copper nanoparticles and medical equipment.

otrosUsos.detalle: coins, pipes, cookware, musical instruments and jewelry.

litio.descripcion: It is an alkali metal found in nature mainly in minerals (such as spodumene and lepidolite). Its main sources are underground brines in evaporitic basins (salt flats), pegmatite rocks and, to a lesser extent, geothermal waters and clays. It is characterized by its low weight, high reactivity and large energy storage capacity, which makes it a strategic resource.

bateriasRecargables.detalle: main use in electronic devices and electric vehicles.

industriaVidrioCeramica.detalle: improves thermal resistance and lowers the melting point of special glasses and ceramics.

lubricantesGrasasIndustriales.detalle: Used in the manufacture of lubricants and greases for industry.

industriaFarmaceutica.detalle: in specific medical treatments. For example, lithium carbonate is used as a mood stabilizer in the treatment of bipolar disorder.

aleacionesAeronauticas.detalle: alloyed with aluminum, copper or magnesium to create light, strong materials for aircraft and trains.

otrosUsos.detalle: in air scrubbers in submarines, industrial air conditioning and as a flux in welding.

cobalto.descripcion: It is a hard, ferromagnetic, bluish-white transition metal found associated with nickel and copper minerals, usually as a by-product of their mining. It is rarely found in significant independent concentrations. It is characterized by high resistance to corrosion and wear, thermal stability and magnetic properties, which make it relevant in a range of technological applications.

bateriasRecargables.detalle: especially lithium-ion batteries. It is a critical component of the cathode in batteries for electric vehicles and electronic devices (phones, laptops).

aleacionesMetalicas.detalle: to improve strength and durability. It is used to make aircraft engine parts, gas turbines and cutting tools that require high resistance to heat and wear.

industriaQuimica.detalle: as a catalyst in industrial processes.

imanesAltoRendimiento.detalle: used to make powerful permanent magnets.

pigmentos.detalle: in the manufacture of ceramics, enamels and glass to obtain the characteristic “cobalt blue”.

medicina.detalle: cobalt-60 is used in radiotherapy to treat cancer and to sterilize medical equipment.

uranio.descripcion: It is a radioactive metal found in nature as part of minerals such as uraninite. It is a strategic resource because of its use as an energy source. It is characterized by its high density and its capacity to generate energy through nuclear fission, which makes it a key element in energy production.

generacionEnergiaNuclear.detalle: fuel in nuclear power plants to generate electricity. Natural uranium is enriched (raising U-235 to 3-5%) for this purpose.

uranioEmpobrecidoU238.detalle: used in military vehicle armor, aircraft counterweights and helicopter rotors because of its extreme density.

aplicacionesMedicasIndustriales.detalle: used in diagnostics and cancer treatment (radiotherapy).

usosHistoricos.detalle: used in the past to color glass and ceramics.

cuarzo.descripcion: It is one of the most abundant minerals in the Earth's crust, surpassed only by feldspars. It is composed of silicon dioxide (SiO₂), formed by a three-dimensional framework of silicon and oxygen tetrahedra. In its pure state it is colorless and transparent, although impurities can give it various colors. It is found in igneous, metamorphic and sedimentary rocks.
cuarzo.origenGeologico: It forms in hydrothermal veins and cavities in igneous and metamorphic rocks. The iron inclusions come from mineralizing fluids during crystallization.

industriaVidriera.detalle: in the manufacture of different types of glass, such as window glass, container glass, flat glass, special glass and fiberglass.

industriaElectrica.detalle: in the manufacture of oscillators, clocks, circuits and communication devices; its ability to resonate at constant frequencies makes it essential.

abrasivos.detalle: abrasive material in silica sands, used for polishing, sanding and cutting various materials because of its hardness (7 on the Mohs scale) and wide availability.

fundicionArena.detalle: used to make molds for metal parts, taking advantage of its high thermal resistance and stability at high temperatures.

feldespato.descripcion: Feldspars are aluminosilicates mixed with varying amounts of potassium, sodium and calcium. Together with quartz they are the most abundant minerals in the crust, about 60%. They are found in igneous, metamorphic and, to a lesser extent, sedimentary rocks. For industrial use they require crushing, grinding and screening. They are characterized by a relatively low melting temperature, chemical stability and fluxing capacity, which makes them essential in many industrial processes.

industriaCeramica.detalle: acts as a flux, aiding fusion and improving the strength of the final product.

industriaVidrio.detalle: helps lower the melting temperature and improves the properties of glass.

pinturasPlasticosCauchos.detalle: used as a filler and extender, providing stability, good dispersion and abrasion resistance.

industriaPapel.detalle: used as a mineral filler to improve physical and optical properties.

baritina.descripcion: It is a mineral composed mainly of barium sulfate (BaSO₄), the main ore of barium, characterized by its unusually high specific gravity (high density) and relative chemical inertness. It usually occurs in white, grayish or yellowish tones, although impurities can give it other colors. It is a non-metallic, inert, stable and non-toxic mineral. Its industrial use is based on its high density, chemical stability and capacity as a filler, which improves the physical properties of many products. It is commonly found in hydrothermal veins, associated with minerals such as galena, sulfides and carbonates, as well as in sedimentary deposits.

industriaPetrolera.detalle: its most important application, where it is used as a weighting agent in drilling muds. Its high density makes it possible to control well pressure, preventing collapses and blowouts during drilling.

industriaQuimica.detalle: used to obtain barium compounds for the manufacture of paints, plastics, glass and various chemical products.

industriaConstruccion.detalle: used as an aggregate in heavy concrete for radiation shielding (hospitals, nuclear power plants) because of its high density.

pinturasRecubrimientos.detalle: acts as a mineral filler, improving properties such as strength, durability and surface finish.

industriaCauchoPlasticos.detalle: used as a filler, providing greater density, stability and mechanical strength to final products.

arenaSilicea.descripcion: It is a sedimentary material and industrial aggregate composed mostly of quartz grains (SiO₂), generally with contents above 95%. It originates from the weathering, transport and accumulation of quartz-rich rocks, forming deposits in fluvial, aeolian and coastal environments. It is characterized by its high purity, hardness and chemical resistance, which makes it a resource of great industrial importance. Its applications are essentially the same as those of quartz, notably in glassmaking, the construction industry, abrasive processes, sand casting and filtration systems. Its industrial use takes advantage of its high silica content, mechanical strength and stable behavior at high temperatures. The main silica sand deposits are found in sedimentary environments such as rivers, dunes and ancient coastal systems, where natural sorting processes concentrate high-purity quartz grains.

diatomea.descripcion: It is a sedimentary material and industrial mineral formed by the accumulation of frustules (shells) of microscopic algae called diatoms, composed mainly of amorphous silica (SiO₂·nH₂O). It originates in lake and marine environments, where the accumulation and compaction of these biogenic remains produce high-purity, highly porous deposits. It is characterized by its low density, high porosity, high absorption capacity and mild abrasive properties, which make it a resource with wide industrial application.

filtracion.detalle: one of its most important uses, as a filter medium in the food (beverages, oils), pharmaceutical and chemical industries.

absorbente.detalle: used to contain liquid spills because of its high absorption capacity.

abrasivoSuave.detalle: present in products such as toothpaste, polishes and cleaners.

aislanteTermicoAcustico.detalle: because of its low thermal conductivity.

agricultura.detalle: used as a natural insecticide and soil conditioner.

granito.descripcion: It is a commercial category within dimension stones, used in the construction and ornamental industries to group stone materials of high hardness, strength and suitability for polishing. In this sense, the term is not strictly limited to granite in the petrographic sense, but includes various igneous and metamorphic rocks with similar physical properties, such as marbles, limestones, basalts, slates and quartzites. It is characterized by high mechanical strength, weather resistance and a good surface finish, which makes it a widely used material.

construccion.detalle: cladding, floors, countertops, stairs and façades.

obraPublica.detalle: paving stones, curbs and gutters, and structural elements.

piedraTriturada.detalle: aggregates for concrete and road bases.

decoracion.detalle: ornamental elements thanks to its variety of colors and textures.

zeolita.descripcion: Zeolites are a group of hydrated aluminosilicate minerals and a non-metallic industrial mineral, characterized by a porous crystalline structure with internal cavities and channels. This structure allows them to exchange cations and adsorb molecules, which is the basis of their applications. They form mainly in volcanic rocks (especially tuffs) through hydrothermal or diagenetic alteration. They stand out for their high cation exchange capacity, high porosity, adsorption capacity and chemical stability, properties that make them a resource of great industrial interest.

tratamientoAgua.detalle: removal of heavy metals, ammonium and other contaminants.

agricultura.detalle: soil improver that retains nutrients and moisture.

ganaderia.detalle: animal feed additive that helps absorb toxins.

industriaQuimica.detalle: as a molecular sieve and catalyst in various processes.

medioAmbiente.detalle: odor control and remediation of contaminated soils.
